notes.title: 0.8.2 Update
notes.notes: [p]Greetings from Team Tapas![/p][p]Today, we’re excited to share news of our long-awaited version 0.8.2 update![/p][p][/p][p]This update focuses on improving areas of the game that felt a bit lacking or cumbersome. It also introduces quite a few balance adjustments. For details, please continue reading.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]0.8.2 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Epilogue 1 Adjustments[/b][/h2][h3]Time Attack System Removed & Berserk Timer Added[/h3][p]Originally by default, we utilized a Time Attack System in Epilogue 1. However, we found that the system felt forced, unnatural, and unintuitive.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, we have removed the Time Attack System from all bosses in Epilogue 1, and in its place, we are introducing a Berserk Timer. The Berserk Timer is applied individually to each boss, and when the timer runs out, [b]the boss’s attack speed will increase by 40%[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We now look forward to seeing how players overcome this new challenge using their mechanics and preferred build choices.[/p][h3][b]Difficulty and Epilogue Exclusive Upgrades Adjusted[/b][/h3][p]Previously, we balanced the difficulty of Epilogue 1 under the assumption that players would have already gotten all of the upgrades they could get in Sil’s House. However, in actuality, players often entered Epilogue 1 with fewer upgrades. So we have rebalanced Epilogue 1 by reducing enemy HP from the first wave by about 15%.[/p][p][/p][p]Furthermore, defeating the final boss used to require a relatively high level of Epilogue 1 exclusive upgrades, which forced players to repeatedly grind for upgrades unnecessarily. To address this, extra seeds will now be generated upon clearing each boss, and enemy HP for the final boss has also been reduced by about 15%.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, to match the lowered difficulty of the final boss, we have removed the [i]Harmony [/i]upgrade from the Epilogue 1 exclusive upgrades. Now, players will need to think strategically about what choices to make within the limited growth cap they have in order to clear Epilogue 1.[/p][list][*][p][b]Enemy HP Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]First Wave: 15% reduction[/p][/*][*][p]First Boss: 11% reduction[/p][/*][*][p]Second Boss: 13% reduction[/p][/*][*][p]Third Boss: 14% reduction[/p][/*][*][p]Final Boss: 15% reduction[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Epilogue 1 Exclusive Upgrade Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Harmony [/i]upgrade removed[/p][/*][*][p]※ If you have seeds invested into the removed [i]Harmony [/i]upgrade, they will be refunded and your maximum seed capacity will be reduced by 150.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Additional Seeds Granted Upon Clearing a Boss[/b][/p][list][*][p]First Boss: 2 seeds[/p][/*][*][p]Second Boss: 4 seeds[/p][/*][*][p]Third Boss: 6 seeds[/p][/*][*][p]Final Boss: 10 seeds[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Epilogue 1 Challenge Mode Adjusted[/b][/h2][p]We have applied the difficulty changes mentioned above to the Epilogue 1 Challenge Mode as well. However, to provide an initial difficulty level similar to before, we have added a new option that increases the HP of all enemies.[/p][list][*][p][b]Existing Difficulty Setting Option Adjusted[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: All enemy HP per wave +0% / 1% / 2% / 3% / 4% (+1 / +5 / +10 / +15 / +20 points)[/p][/*][*][p]After: All enemy HP per wave +0% / 1% / 2% (+1 / +5 / +10 points)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Side Missions Adjusted[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added UI that displays the mission objective and a brief description when entering each side the “Powerful Strike” mission.[/p][list][*][p]Inflict 9,000 or more damage → Inflict 6,000 or more damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the clear requirements for the “Getting Used to Giant Scissors” mission.[/p][list][*][p]Inflict 10,000 or more damage → Inflict 9,000 or more damage[/p][/*][*][p]Requirement count: 20 times / 30 times → 15 times / 20 times[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the clear requirements for the “Getting Used to Magic Scissors” mission.[/p][list][*][p]Requirement 1: Defeat 7 enemies → Defeat 5 enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Requirement 2: Defeat 14 enemies → Defeat 12 enemies[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the clear requirements for the “Getting Used to Broken Scissors” mission.[/p][list][*][p]Requirement 1: Inflict 250,000 cumulative damage → Inflict 150,000 cumulative damage[/p][/*][*][p]Requirement 2: Inflict 400,000 cumulative damage → Inflict 300,000 cumulative damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Skill Balance Adjusted[/b][/h2][h3][b]Giant Scissors[/b][/h3][p]Although Giant Scissors had sufficient late-game potential, there was feedback that its unique long delay between attacks made it unwieldy in the early to mid-game. To address this, we increased its attack speed to make it feel less unwieldy and adjusted its damage to maintain its original performance level.[/p][list][*][p][b]Before[/b][/p][list][*][p]Attacks the enemy with scissors. Sharpness efficiency is increased by 2 times, but all Sharpness is removed upon hitting with Scissors. After a fixed number of hits, the next attack will be a Critical Hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage: [b]300%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Attack Speed: [b]1.1 per sec[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]After[/b][/p][list][*][p]Attacks the enemy with scissors. Sharpness efficiency is increased by 3 times, but all Sharpness is removed upon hitting with Scissors. After a fixed number of hits, the next attack will be a Critical Hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage:[b] 250%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Attack Speed: [b]1.8 per sec[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Counter[/b][/h3][p]There was feedback that Counter didn’t provide sufficient returns compared to its difficulty of use. To address this, its difficulty of use has been slightly eased, and its returns have been strengthened. [/p][list][*][p][b]Before[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blocks most damage for [b]0.3s[/b]. Upon blocking an enemy attack, become immune to all damage for [b]0.7s [/b]and attack all nearby enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage: [b]1000% [/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]After[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blocks most damage for [b]0.4s[/b]. Upon blocking an enemy attack, become immune to all damage for [b]1s [/b]and attack all nearby enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage: [b]1200%[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Scissor Attribute[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: When Counter inflicts a hit, [b]gains 150% Sharpness[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After: When Counter inflicts a hit, [b]500% of Scissors damage is inflicted as Additional Damage[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Cooldown Attribute[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: When Counter inflicts a hit, cooldown of Counter is decreased by [b]3s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After: When Counter inflicts a hit, cooldown of Counter is decreased by [b]5s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Thread Attribute[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: Shoots [b]3 Needles[/b] at every target hit by Counter.[/p][/*][*][p]After: Shoots [b]5 Needles[/b] at every target hit by Counter.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Flower Attribute[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: When Counter inflicts a hit, spawns[b] 3[/b] [b]Flowers[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After: When Counter inflicts a hit, spawns [b]5[/b] [b]Flowers[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Crow Attribute[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: When Counter inflicts a hit, summons [b]3[/b] [b]Crows[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After: When Counter inflicts a hit, summons [b]5 Crows[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Blood Attribute[/b][/p][list][*][p]Before: When Counter inflicts a hit, spawns [b]3 Blood Clots[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After: When Counter inflicts a hit, spawns [b]5[/b] [b]Blood Clots[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Leech[/b][/h3][p]We have changed the skill’s name because “Leech” could be misunderstood in some languages as a skill that restores the player’s health. The skill’s name now matches the actual visual and nature of the skill better.[/p][list][*][p]The skill name has been changed from “[b]Leech[/b]” to “[b]Blood Marble[/b].”[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Synergy & Witchcraft Attribute Balance Adjusted[/b][/h2][h3][b]Synergies[/b][/h3][p]We adjusted some dual synergies that underperformed in the previous version of the game. Although a full-scale rework of dual synergies is planned for the future, we hope that this adjustment will provide some immediate improvements to build diversity.[/p][list][*][p]Blood 7 / Fire 7[/p][list][*][p]Before: When a Blood Clot is absorbed, [b]has a 10% chance to Burn[/b] all enemies within 3m for 200% of ATK.[/p][/*][*][p]After: When a Blood Clot is absorbed, [b]Burn[/b] all enemies within 3m for 200% of ATK.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Thread 7 / Fire 7[/p][list][*][p]Before: All Combustion is increased by 20% per connected Thread.[/p][/*][*][p]After: Enemy HP is burned for 40% of Needle damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Witchcraft Attributes[/b][/h3][p]Minus a few builds, we determined that the damage of Needles, Crows, and Flowers still fell short of our expectations. So we have buffed their overall performance.[/p][list][*][p]Needle: Increased base damage of needles from [b]60% [/b]to [b]80%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Crow: Increased base damage of crows from[b] 60%[/b] to [b]100%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Flower: Increased base damage of flowers from [b]200% [/b]to [b]260%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Existing Chapter Boss Difficulty Adjusted[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Chapter 4: pattern where grid-shaped danger zones appear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Chapter 4: Nahatra Phase 2[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the density of projectiles in the attack pattern where rectangular danger zones appear together with multiple projectiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the difficulty of the attack pattern where fan-shaped and donut-shaped danger zones appear simultaneously.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the difficulty of the pattern where large and small fan-shaped danger zones appear multiple times.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Gamepad Settings Improved[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added an option in the settings menu to invert the Confirm/Cancel buttons.[/p][list][*][p]Example: DualShock → ㅇ / × buttons, Xbox Controller → A / B buttons[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a Vibration On/Off option in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a UI in the settings menu to check combat key bindings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain controllers such as the Switch Controller and Pro Controller were not recognized or had incorrect key mappings applied.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ambush would not cross to the other side of an enemy in certain boss battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Flower 6 synergy damage was applied lower than intended in Epilogue 1 and in Epilogue 1 Challenge Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain homing projectiles would remain in the air for too long under specific conditions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Note about Upcoming Schedule[/b][/h1][p]We are currently working hard on preparing a new epilogue chapter with the goal of releasing it by the end of November. We want to keep bringing fresh and enjoyable game experiences to you, so we are also in the midst of planning various types of new content for you to enjoy. In regards to this new content, we will be sharing a brief update in the near future. So stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to your valuable feedback and support, [i]Garden of Witches[/i] is gradually blossoming into something even more beautiful. We will continue to do our best so that you can keep enjoying the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, we sincerely thank you.[/p][p][/p][p]– Team Tapas[/p]

notes.title: 0.8.1 Patch Notes & Epilogue 1 Dev Blog
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings from Team Tapas![/p][p][/p][p]With the 0.8.0 patch, we released our very first Epilogue Chapter (Epilogue 1). This update was about more than just adding a new stage. It was an important attempt for us to introduce and test a new system with a different tempo from our main story chapters.[/p][p][/p][p]While preparing Epilogue 1, we asked ourselves, “How can we make the game more fun while keeping it fresh?” and “How can we show our players the potential of the epilogue chapters?” As we challenged ourselves with preparing Epilogue 1, we were able to try new ideas while identifying areas that needed improvement. [/p][p][/p][p]In this dev blog, we’d like to share our reflections as we created and changed Epilogue 1 and share the future direction of the game.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Epilogue 1 Dev Review[/b][/h1][p]Compared to Chapters 1-4, Epilogue 1 has a much faster tempo that centers on creating and optimizing builds with the newly introduced Special Skill System. During production, we had a blast experimenting with a variety of ideas. However, we noticed a few problems.[/p][p][/p][p]The most notable issue was the Time-Attack System that we implemented during each boss battle. Compared to bosses in previous chapters, the Epilogue 1 bosses were designed with simpler and easier attack patterns. When we tested the game without the Time-Attack System, players were able to clear Epilogue 1 even with low stats, but the problem was that it took too long.[/p][p]
When players did not fully upgrade Sil and were on a low-spec playthrough, battles dragged on excessively and the game felt tedious. To prevent this, we introduced the Time-Attack System. However, the Time-Attack System also highlighted areas that needed improvement.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Issues with the Time-Attack System[/b][/h2][p]The first issue with the Time-Attack System was that players often did not immediately realize that a time-attack was in effect during the boss fights. Although a clock UI appeared at the start of the battle, it was not very noticeable. So after the player ran out of time, many players did not understand why the boss suddenly used a wipe-out attack.[/p][p]
The second issue was that the Time-Attack System itself did not directly address the core issue that players had on a low-spec playthrough. We wanted to create mechanics that would encourage players to reach a certain level of stats to clear the game, but the Time-Attack System felt insufficient. We now realize that players would have had a better game experience if the difficulty had been adjusted more naturally through learning monster attack patterns, learning how to optimize builds, and improving the presentation of the boss battle. [/p][p][/p][p]The last issue was that the base stats required to clear the boss within the set time was set a little too high. When designing the difficulty, we assumed players would have fully upgraded Sil while progressing through Chapters 1-4. In practice, however, many players reached Epilogue 1 without fully upgrading Sil. This meant that players often had to push Epilogue-exclusive upgrades to very high levels, which led to excessive repetition.[/p][p][/p][p]To address these issues in the 0.8.1 update, players can now increase their progress for certain achievements while playing Epilogue 1 and the Time-Attack UI has been made more visible during boss fights. We hope these changes will reduce confusion and give players a clearer sense of how to progress.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]0.8.1 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Improved the visibility of the UI that shows the remaining time in the Epilogue 1 boss battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Progress for the following achievements can now also be earned in Epilogue 1:[/p][list][*][p]Reach n Cumulative Boss Battle Clear(s) (n increases once per boss defeated)[/p][/*][*][p]Reach n Cumulative Normal Battle Clear(s) (n increases once per wave cleared)[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat Boss n time(s) using `Giant Scissors` (n increases once per boss defeated)[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat Boss n time(s) using `Magic Scissors` (n increases once per boss defeated)[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat Boss n time(s) using `Broken Scissors` (n increases once per boss defeated)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Leech Ring artifact caused abnormal damage scaling on the Leech spell.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in some challenge modes where the Difficulty Selection UI would not close with the ESC key. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the time limit gauge would not appear under certain conditions in some of the side missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the scissors used in a side mission were forcibly equipped after playing the side mission and returning to another chapter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some of the attack patterns of the final boss in Epilogue 1 did not deal damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various text and UI errors.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Future Update Roadmap[/b][/h1][p]Currently, we are preparing Epilogue 2. After that, we plan to sequentially add Epilogue 3, rework existing chapters, improve Challenge Mode, expand Side Missions, and add a Card and Costume system. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Epilogue 2[/b][/h2][p]Our next update will introduce Epilogue 2, designed to emphasize the fun of optimizing builds while exploring a wide dungeon. Epilogue 2 will feature our most complex map, and in this map, you will be able to optimize your build and experience combat and growth in diverse ways.[/p][p][/p][p]The foundation of Epilogue 2 will be built on a new Artifact System. You will store dropped artifacts in a limited inventory and need to strategically choose which items to buy in shops and which items to upgrade through synthesis. The playstyle will be similar to deck-building games.[/p][p][/p][p]The Special Skill System will also be expanded. Building upon the system introduced in Epilogue 1, you will be able to gradually enhance special skills through artifacts and a growth system, allowing for even more build variety. [/p][p][/p][p]Learning from our mistakes with Epilogue 1, Epilogue 2 will be designed to reduce the burden of repetitive play. It will focus more on in-combat growth and learning rather than permanent progression from upgrading Sil. Our goal is to make each run feel more meaningful and immersive.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Content Expansion[/b][/h2][p]We also plan to improve Challenge Mode, expand Side Missions, and introduce a Card and Costume System. Based on certain playstyles you can achieve in each chapter, we plan to add in new ways to clear Challenge Mode and new Side Missions. The rewards will include new cards and costumes. Currently, the only way to experience Challenge Mode is by adjusting the difficulty of certain numbers. In the future, we will provide deeper strategic challenges and new goals.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Reworks of Existing Chapters[/b][/h2][p]We plan to rework Chapters 1-4 and Epilogue 1.[/p][p][/p][p]Since Chapters 1-4 shape players’ first impressions of the game, we want to refine them with particular care. We aim to diversify normal monsters and room types, improve certain systems, expand build options, re-tune difficulty and growth curves, and improve overall balance for a smoother early-game experience.[/p][p][/p][p]As mentioned earlier with Epilogue 1, we also plan to improve the Time-Attack System. Rather than relying heavily on time limits, we will enhance the presentation of each boss battle and the design of their attack patterns so that players can naturally improve and learn how to optimize builds as they play the game.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Closing Remarks[/b][/h1][p]In this dev blog, we shared the 0.8.1 patch notes, our reflections on Epilogue 1, and our future plans. Of course, there were many more ideas and challenges that we could have covered, and there are still many areas that we can improve on. But we wanted to focus on what is most important to us. You.[/p][p][/p][p]All of the feedback you’ve given us until now has become a tremendous source of support for us. We always strive to carefully review your comments on Steam, Discord and other channels, and the ideas and critiques you have provided have played a key role in shaping our game. In the future as well, we hope you will continue to support us.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to deliver new content and improvements so that your journey in Garden of Witches always feels fresh and enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: 0.8.0 Update
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings from Team Tapas!

Thank you, as always, for supporting us and patiently waiting for our next update.

Version 0.8.0 will add the first main content expansion (an epilogue chapter) for Garden of Witches, introducing a new witch and a new area. It features a different progression style from the other chapters, offering a fresh gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Epilogue 1: The Swamp Witch[/b][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="wXZdvww7wyk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/35ab76d9835750807363f8adc9202cf9a5413a0a.png"][/img][/p][p]Nahatra’s growth has caused side effects that are shaking up the Garden. To stabilize the Garden, help the troubled [b]Swamp Witch, Maydel[/b], solve her problem and invite her to the tea party. Of course, like other domains in the Garden, Maydel’s swamp won’t be particularly friendly to Sil.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][p]Unlike previous chapters, this epilogue is structured as a [b]single map[/b]. Countless waves of enemies and successive mid-bosses will block Sil’s path. [b]Defeat enemies within the time limit to earn greater rewards, and complete your build to take down the main boss![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Weapon: Singing Scissors[/b][/h3][p]After helping Maydel solve her problem, she will gift Sil with a [b]new weapon, Singing Scissors,[/b] as a token of gratitude. When activated, Singing Scissors will perform [b]ranged attacks for a set duration[/b]. We hope this will inspire new build combinations.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Special Ability[/b][/h3][p]In Maydel’s swamp domain, a [b]special ability[/b] powered by Maydel becomes available. It can be used via a new action button and [b]enhances Sil’s abilities in various ways[/b]. This ability is a unique system [b]available only in Maydel’s swamp domain[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1][b]0.8.0 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p]※ When updating to version 0.8.0, any ongoing runs will be reset.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2][p]We have added a new epilogue chapter.[/p][p][/p][p]※ After updating the game, if you continue with existing save data where you have cleared Chapter 5, you can interact with the [b]book [/b]in Sil’s House to open the [b]Chapter Selection UI[/b] and proceed from there.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2][p]We found that completing Dual Synergies was too difficult, so we have reduced the tag requirement from 8 to 7. As a result, the maximum level of passive traits for the five attributes has been lowered from 5 to 4.

We also found that building up the Thread, Flower, and Crow passive attributes was a bit difficult, so we increased their early-game damage and adjusted their growth rate. Overall, Thread, Flower, and Crow damage has increased by about 37% at 6 tags, and by about 12% at their maximum tag count (previously 8, now 7).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Attributes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Thread[/p][list][*][p]Base Damage: 30% → 60%[/p][/*][*][p]Passive Trait: 30% → 10% (per level)[/p][/*][*][p]Max Passive Level: 5 → 4[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Flower[/p][list][*][p]Base Damage: 100% → 200%[/p][/*][*][p]Passive Trait: 30% → 10% (per level)[/p][/*][*][p]Max Passive Level: 5 → 4[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Crow[/p][list][*][p]Base Damage: 30% → 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Passive Trait: 30% → 10% (per level)[/p][/*][*][p]Max Passive Level: 5 → 4[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Blood[/p][list][*][p]Max Passive Level: 5 → 4[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fire[/p][list][*][p]Max Passive Level: 5 → 4[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dual Synergies[/p][list][*][p]Tag Requirement: 8 → 7[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]System Changes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Shortcut Buttons[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a hotkey to change magic slot positions[/p][list][*][p]Keyboard: R[/p][/*][*][p]Controller: D-pad →[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a new hotkey for the epilogue special ability[/p][list][*][p]The new key will be available only in Epilogue Chapter 1[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard: Shift[/p][/*][*][p]Controller: RB / LB (both triggers work)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added alternative normal attack hotkeys[/p][list][*][p]Controller: RT / LT (both triggers work)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed various text errors.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Closing Remarks[/b][/h1][p]Until our official 1.0 release, we plan to continue expanding Garden of Witches in various ways, starting with this epilogue chapter. Please look forward to the new witches and stories to come.

As always, thank you for appreciating what we have made with Garden of Witches and continuing to be patient with us. We will do our best to repay your support with an even more polished game.

Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: 0.7.0 Update
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings from Team Tapas!

We would like to express our sincere thanks to everyone who has been waiting for and supporting this update.

In version 0.7.0, we are introducing [b]Side Mission Chapters[/b] and a [b]Card System[/b]. We have designed Side Mission Chapters to help players better understand unique combat systems in Garden of Witches, such as Blood Clots and the Butterfly Walk gauge. During Side Missions, players will have to achieve simple objectives while trying out various builds. After completing a Side Mission, players will be rewarded with cards that enhance Sil’s stats or strengthen effects of certain attacks.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]0.7.0 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][h2][b]Side Mission Chapters Added[/b][/h2][p]We have added Side Mission Chapters, where you can complete simple objectives and earn rewards. You can access the Side Mission Chapters by clearing certain chapters or meeting specific conditions and then interacting with the [b]book in the House of Threads (Sil’s House)[/b] to open the [b]Chapter Selection UI[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Card System Added[/b][/h2][p]We have added a Card System, which enhances Sil’s base stats or strengthens certain attacks like her spells and scissors. Cards can be obtained through the Side Mission Chapters, and you can view your collected cards via the [b]Card Tab[/b] by opening the [b]Upgrade UI (upgrade table)[/b] in the House of Threads.

Below are some of the newly added cards.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="161,"][tr][td colwidth="161"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/0378721093d15889316d970892f24c00ddd851d1.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colspan="2"][p][b]Sea of Blood[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Leech[/b] can be stack cast.[/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="161"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/d6264d8fd30d9ba76bd0497c12a86e1dcfa6ca78.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colspan="2"][p][b]Wheel of Fortune[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Sewing Wheel[/b] Homing SPD is increased by [b]200%[/b] and Return SPD is decreased by [b]20%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="161"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/81b93da1df6da3df0c4e31d9ca720ab55fdb9c98.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colspan="2"][p][b]Hunter[/b][/p][list][*][p]When [b]Broken Scissors[/b] are equipped, [b]Sharpness[/b] duration is increased by [b]3s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h2][b]Skill Adjustments[/b][/h2][h3][b]Dash[/b][/h3][p][b]The ability to avoid most damage[/b] while dashing is now a default feature.[/p][list][*][p]Before: Quickly move [b]4m[/b] in the desired direction.[/p][/*][*][p]After: Quickly dashes [b]4m[/b] in the desired direction, momentarily blocking most damage.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Giant Scissors[/b][/h3][p]The incentive for using Giant Scissors over other scissors seemed a bit underwhelming, so it has been buffed.[/p][list][*][p]Sharpness efficiency: 1.5x → 2x[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Broken Scissors[/b][/h3][p]The payoff for using Broken Scissors effectively compared to its difficulty of use was unsatisfying, so it has been buffed.[/p][list][*][p]Damage: 80% → 120%[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Difficulty System and UI Changes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Very Hard Mode Added & Difficulty UI Design Updated[/b][/h3][p]We have added a Very Hard Mode. We will do our utmost to deliver a more polished and completed game in return.

Thank you![/p]

notes.title: 0.6.0 Patch Notes and Future Updates
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings from Team Tapas![/p][p]We thank everyone who participated in the recent 0.6.0 beta test. Based on your valuable feedback, we have now updated the standard version of the game.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]0.6.0 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]System Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The following changes will be applied with the update:[/p][list][*][p]If you have saved the game in the middle of a run, Sil will return to her home in the corresponding chapter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]High scores[/b] from the [b]Challenge Chapter[/b] will be reset.[/p][list][*][p]However, records achieved in version 0.5.n will be saved separately and may be displayed through a different UI in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]※ Progress made in the 0.6.0 beta will also be reset.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If you have learned the [b]counterattack skill[/b], the special [b]“Underwater Map”[/b] that appears under specific conditions starting from Chapter 2 [b]will no longer appear[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When selecting a reward to [b]remove a tag[/b], you can now choose and [b]remove any tag from all existing tags[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dice Shop[/b][/p][list][*][p]When [b]replacing a spell’s attribute upgrade[/b], the selected attribute will no longer appear among the choices.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where after getting all four scissor attribute upgrades, only the attribute selected for replacement would appear as an option when trying to switch attributes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Chapter Rework and Difficulty Adjustments[/b][/h2][p]Due to this round of balance changes, most builds now deal significantly more damage. To compensate, enemy health has been increased across all chapters. Additionally, the activation timing of new mechanics introduced in each chapter has been moved forward by one chapter, allowing new players to access core systems more quickly. notes.title: 0.6.0 Beta Patch Notes and Schedule Update
notes.notes:
Greetings from Team Tapas!

We would like to thank everyone who has supported us and waited patiently for the upcoming update. We are currently preparing new content including an epilogue chapter, side missions, and various other additions.

However, it has been difficult to release the full update during the originally planned summer sale period, so we’ve decided to stagger our updates in stages. We sincerely apologize for not meeting your expectations and will share our revised timeline and updated details with you as soon as possible.

For now, version 0.6.0 will focus on adjustments to the current content and balance of the game. These changes will have a significant impact on your overall gameplay experience, so we would like to collect your feedback through a beta test.

We have prepared the 0.6.0 Beta Test in advance and will do our best to listen to your voices so that we can continue to move the game forward in a better direction.


[h1][b]0.6.0 Beta Patch Notes[/b][/h1]
The 0.6.0 update is being released ahead of schedule as a beta. If no critical issues are found, it will be officially deployed within a few days. For instructions on how to participate in the beta test, please check [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2530470/view/517465051240595750]this link[/url]].

[h2][b]System Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]The following changes will be applied with the update:
[list]
[*]If you have saved the game in the middle of a run, Sil will return to her home in the corresponding chapter.
[*][b]High scores[/b] from the [b]Challenge Chapter[/b] will be reset.
[list]
[*]However, records achieved in version 0.5.n will be saved separately and may be displayed through a different UI in the future.
[/list][/list][*]If you have learned the [b]counterattack skill[/b], the special [b]“Underwater Map”[/b] that appears under specific conditions starting from Chapter 2 [b]will no longer appear[/b].
[*]When selecting a reward to [b]remove a tag[/b], you can now choose and [b]remove any tag from all existing tags[/b].
[/list]
[h2][b]Chapter Rework and Difficulty Adjustments[/b][/h2]
Due to this round of balance changes, most builds now deal significantly more damage. To compensate, enemy health has been increased across all chapters. Additionally, the activation timing of new mechanics introduced in each chapter has been moved forward by one chapter, allowing new players to access core systems more quickly. For Chapter 4, no new systems will be introduced yet, but side missions and rewards will be added in a future update.

[h3][b]Chapter 1[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Synergies[/b] are now available starting from [b]Chapter 1[/b].
[*]The number of floors per domain has been increased by 1.
[*]The enemy health scaling curve has been adjusted as follows:
[list]
[*]First battle: No changes.
[*]Final boss: ~360% increase.
[/list][/list][h3][b]Chapter 2[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Relics and the dice shop[/b] now appear from [b]Chapter 2[/b].
[*]The enemy health scaling curve has been adjusted as follows:
[list]
[*]First battle: ~40% increase.
[*]Final boss: ~454% increase.
[/list][/list][h3][b]Chapter 3[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Players can now select [b]new scissors[/b] starting from [b]Chapter 3[/b].
[*]The enemy health scaling curve has been adjusted as follows:
[list]

[*]Final boss: ~161% increase.
[/list][/list][h3][b]Chapter 4[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The enemy health scaling curve has been adjusted as follows:
[list]
[*]First battle: ~20% increase.
[*]Final boss: ~167% increase.
[/list][/list]
[h2][b]Boss Attack Pattern Difficulty Adjustments[/b][/h2]
Some high-difficulty attack patterns have been toned down to make them easier to avoid. For Nahatra’s second phase in Chapter 4, since the difficulty of her attack patterns has been reduced, her damage dealt has increased. This change is intended to discourage players from simply ignoring her attack patterns in favor of clearing the fight by tanking hits.
[list]
[*]Chloe’s Intermission Phase (Chapter 3):
[list]
[*]The health of the spider cocoons has been reduced by ~30%.
[/list][*]Nahatra’s First Phase (Chapter 4):
[list]
[*]Added warning indicators to certain attack patterns.
[*]Adjusted the position of the safe zone during the final explosion pattern of her intermission phase to make it easier to find.
[/list][*]Nahata’s Second Phase (Chapter 4)
[list]
[*]The difficulty of various attack patterns has been lowered, but damage has been increased to maintain the overall difficulty of the battle.
[/list][/list]
[h2][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Sil’s Base Stats[/b][/h3]
To create a smoother first-time experience while encouraging more natural retry loops, we’ve reduced the base health but improved other aspects of gameplay. Additionally, we’ve slightly increased movement speed and improved the invincibility duration after taking damage.
[list]
[*]Increased [b]base movement speed[/b] from [b]5 m/s[/b] to [b]6 m/s[/b].
[*]Reduced [b]base health[/b] from [b]50[/b] to [b]25[/b].
[*]Increased the player’s [b]invincibility duration[/b] after taking a hit from [b]0.3[/b] seconds to [b]0.5[/b] seconds, with a gauge now showing the remaining invisibility duration.
[*]Adjusted the way Sil takes damage so that the player will not take multiple hits simultaneously in the same frame.
[*]Fixed an issue where [b]invincibility frames[/b] were not applied properly when hit during the use of [b]Butterfly Step[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Upgrade Table[/b][/h3]
We have adjusted the beginning structure of the upgrade table and the value of certain enhancements to align with Sil’s new base stats and the attack speed of each scissor variant.

[b]Row 1, Column 1[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Scissor attack speed +0.25 attacks/sec
[*]After: Scissor attack speed +0.2 attacks/sec
[/list][b]Row 1, Column 2[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Max HP +10
[*]After: Max HP +5
[/list][b]Row 1, Column 3[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Movement speed +0.5 m/s
[*]After: Movement speed +0.25 m/s
[/list][b]Row 2, Column 1[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Scissor attack speed +0.25 attacks/sec
[*]After: Max HP +10
[/list][b]Row 2, Column 2[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Movement speed +0.5m/sec
[*]After: Movement speed +0.25m/sec
[/list]
[h3][b]Buff Effects[/b][/h3]
We have adjusted the effects and values of various buffs to improve their viability. For Magic builds, players can gain stacks of [b]Spell Rampage[/b] from critical hits with magic scissors and use a stack of Spell Ramage to increase the damage of a skill. For Sharpness builds, the [b]maximum amount of Sharpness[/b] that can be gained has been increased, allowing Broken Scissors and Giant Scissors to dish out more damage than before.
[list]
[*]Increased [b]Sharpness max capacity[/b] from 200% → 500%
[*]Reworked [b]Spell Ramage[/b] functionality:
[list]
[*]Before: Increased the damage of a skill based on how much Spell Ramage you had and reset after use.
[*]After: Skill damage deals +30% damage and consumes 1 stack of Spell Ramage.
[*]Increased [b]Spell Enhance max capacity[/b] from 50% → 60%
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Scissors[/b][/h3]
We’ve increased the [b]base attack speed[/b] of all scissors to improve the feel of the first playthrough of the game. [b]Broken Scissors[/b] has also been modified to be the best choice for builds that focus on close-range sustained damage.

[b]Normal Scissors[/b]
[list]
[*]Attack speed: 1.5/sec → 1.8/sec
[/list][b]Giant Scissors[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage: 300% → 250%
[*]Attack speed: 0.8/sec → 1.1/sec
[/list][b]Magic Scissors[/b]
[list]
[*]Attack speed: 1.5/sec → 1.8/sec
[*]Spell damage bonus: 30% → 60%
[*]Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where repeated casts under certain conditions wouldn’t charge the critical hit counter
[*]Fixed a priority issue where pressing both spell and scissors buttons would cast scissors first
[/list][/list][b]Broken Scissors[/b]
[list]
[*]Functionality changed:
[list]
[*]Before: After a fixed number of hits, the next attack will be a [b]Critical Hit[/b].
[*]After: Same as above, [b]plus +1000% Sharpness max capacity[/b]
[/list][*]Damage: 40% → 60%
[*]Attack speed: 3.5/sec → 2.8/sec
[*]Hits required for critical: 2 → 1
[/list][b]Attribute Changes[/b]

We have adjusted the magic attribute for scissors so that it aligns with the effectiveness of the Spell Rampage buff.
[list]
[*][b]Spell Ramage[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: When Scissors inflict a [b]Critical Hit[/b], increase spell damage by 30%.
[*]After: When Scissors inflict a [b]Critical Hit[/b], gain [b]1 stack of Spell Rampage[/b].
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Slash[/b][/h3]
To match its high difficulty of use, we’ve buffed Slash’s Scissors attributes.

[b]Attribute Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Scissors[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Deals [b]additional damage[/b] equal to [b]180%[/b] of Scissors damage
[*]After: Deals [b]additional damage[/b] equal to [b]240%[/b] of Scissors damage
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Ambush[/b][/h3]
To improve its synergy with Butterfly Step, the Flower attribute has been reworked.

[b]Attribute Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Flower[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Spawn [b]2 Flowers[/b] upon hit.
[*]After: When using [b]Ambush[/b], wither all [b]Flowers[/b] within 5m and decrease [b]cooldown by 1 second[/b] per withered [b]Flower[/b].
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Counter Attack[/b][/h3]
We’re improving the usability of Counter so it becomes a viable option in more builds. Over time, we’ll continue to tune it to provide stronger effects in the hands of skilled players.

[b]Base Ability[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Blocks most damage for [b]0.25s.[/b] Successful blocks grant [b]0.5s[/b] of immunity and nearby enemies take damage.
[*]After: Blocks most damage for [b]0.3s[/b]. Successful blocks grant [b]0.7s[/b] of immunity.
[*]Cooldown: 16s → 15s
[/list]
[b]Attribute Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Scissors[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Gain [b]100% Sharpness[/b] when you[b] counter[/b] a hit.
[*]After: Gain [b]150% Sharpness[/b] when you [b]counter[/b] a hit.
[/list][*][b]Cooldown[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Decreases the [b]cooldown of other cooldown[/b] based skills by [b]2s[/b] when you [b]counter[/b] a hit.
[*]After: Reduces the cooldown of [b]Counter itself[/b] by [b]3s[/b] when you [b]counter[/b] a hit.
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Summon Doll[/b][/h3]
We increased Summon Doll’s attack range so the skill handles attacking groups of enemies better. To balance its high utility with Scissors and Sharpeness builds, we have slightly reduced its damage output.

[b]Base Ability[/b]
[list]
[*]Attack range: 3m → 5m
[*]Attack width: 0.8m → 1.5m
[/list]
[b]Attribute Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Scissors[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Deals [b]additional damage[/b] equal to [b]45%[/b] of Scissor damage.
[*]After: Deals [b]additional damage[/b] equal to [b]35%[/b] of Scissor damage.
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Sewing Wheel[/b][/h3]
We originally designed this skill as a core spell for Charge builds, but it no longer fits that role. We’ve removed its built-in additional Charge and slightly increased its damage.

[b]Base Ability[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage: 240%/sec → 250%/sec
[*]Charges: 1 → 0
[/list]
[b]Attribute Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Thread[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Every 2s[/b], cut [b]1 Thread[/b] for all enemies hit and each cut reduces its [b]cooldown[/b] by [b]1s[/b].
[*]After: [b]Every 2s[/b], cut [b]1 Thread[/b] for all enemies hit and each cut reduces its [b]cooldown[/b] by [b]2s[/b].
[/list][*][b]Flower[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Each hit causes [b]Flowers[/b] to wither and its [b]cooldown[/b] is reduced by [b]1s[/b] per withered [b]Flower[/b].
[*]After: Each hit causes [b]Flowers[/b] to wither and its [b]cooldown[/b] is reduced by [b]2s[/b] per withered [b]Flower[/b].
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Needle Shot[/b][/h3]
We’ve enhanced certain attributes to bring this skill closer in performance to [b]Shadow Surge[/b].

[b]Attribute Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Cooldown[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: When casting [b]Needle Shot[/b], the [b]Cooldown of all other Cooldown skills[/b] is decreased by [b]1s[/b].
[*]After: When casting [b]Needle Shot[/b], the [b]Cooldown of all other Cooldown skills[/b] is decreased by [b]1.5s[/b].
[/list][*][b]Thread[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Needle Shot[/b] shoots [b]1[/b] additional Needle.
[*]After:[b] Needle Shot[/b] shoots [b]2[/b] additional Needles.
[/list][*][b]Crow[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: When casting [b]Needle Shot[/b], up to 3 summoned [b]crows[/b] are removed. [b]Cooldown[/b] is decreased by [b]15%[/b] per removed [b]Crow[/b].
[*]After: When casting [b]Needle Shot[/b], up to 3 summoned [b]crows[/b] are removed. [b]Cooldown[/b] is decreased by [b]30%[/b] per removed [b]Crow[/b].
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Butterfly Walk[/b][/h3]
In anticipation of future buffs, we’ve slightly increased the speed the gauge fills up.

[b]Base Ability[/b]
[list]
[*]Speed the gauge fills up: 130%/s → 150%/s
[/list]
[h3][b]Leech[/b][/h3]
We’ve adjusted various attributes to shift this skill’s role towards generating resources or buffs more efficiently.

[b]Attribute Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Scissors[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Duration of [b]Leech[/b] increases by [b]0.5s[/b] whenever you land a hit with [b]Scissors[/b]
[*]After: Every [b]1s[/b] while [b]Leech[/b] is inflicting damage, gain [b]30% Sharpness[/b].
[/list][*][b]Thread[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Every [b]2s[/b] while [b]Leech[/b] is inflicting damage, cut [b]1 Thread[/b] and deal bonus damage every second.
[*]After: Every [b]2s[/b] while [b]Leech[/b] is inflicting damage, shoot [b]1 Needle[/b] at all enemies within 5m.
[/list][*][b]Flower[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Leech[/b] withers every [b]Flower[/b] it touches and its duration is increased by [b]0.5s [/b]per withered [b]Flower[/b].
[*]After: While [b]Leech[/b] is inflicting damage, spawn [b]1 Flower[/b] every [b]2s[/b].
[/list][*][b]Crow[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Every [b]3s[/b] while [b]Leech[/b] is inflicting damage, summon [b]1 Crow[/b].
[*]After: Every [b]2s[/b] while [b]Leech[/b] is inflicting damage, summon [b]1 Crow[/b].
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Fireball[/b][/h3]
Previously, Fireball was a bit too effective as a general-purpose spell. We have rebalanced it to better fit into Fire builds.

[b]Base Ability[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage: 1100% → 500%
[*]Burn amount: 40% → 80%
[/list]
[h3][b]Synergy Buffs[/b][/h3]

[b]4 Scissors[/b]

Adjusted this synergy to account for the buffs to [b]Sharpness[/b].
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Sharpness[/b] Max Count is increased by [b]200%[/b] and Duration is increased by 100%.
[*]After: [b]Sharpness[/b] Max Count is increased by [b]500%[/b] and Duration is increased by 100%.
[/list]
[b]6 Scissors[/b]

Due to changes with the [b]Beast Gloves[/b] relic, the calculation method for [b]Critical Hit DMG[/b] has been revised.
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Scissors[/b] damage is increased by [b]50%[/b] and [b]Critical Hit DMG[/b] is [b]increased to 100%[/b].
[*]After: [b]Scissors[/b] damage is increased by [b]50%[/b] and [b]Critical Hit DMG[/b] is [b]increased by 100%[/b].
[/list]
[b]2 Magic[/b]

To increase overall [b]spell[/b] damage, [b]synergy buffs[/b] for getting [b]2, 4, and 6 Magic attributes[/b] have been buffed.
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Spell[/b] damage is increased by [b]10%[/b].
[*]After: [b]Spell[/b] damage is increased by [b]30%[/b].
[/list]
[b]4 Magic[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Spell[/b] damage is increased by [b]10%[/b].
[*]After: [b]Spell[/b] damage is increased by [b]30%[/b].
[/list]
[b]6 Magic[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Gain 1% Spell Enhance[/b] every time a [b]Spell[/b] is used.
[*]After: [b]Gain 2% Spell Enhance[/b] every time a [b]Spell[/b] is used.
[/list]
[b]6 Thread[/b]

We buffed this synergy to make Thread-based builds more viable.
[list]
[*]Before: When the [b]Threads[/b] connected to a target are severed, [b]each severed Thread[/b] inflicts [b]200%[/b] of [b]Needle[/b] damage. When [b]Threads[/b] reach Max Stack and a new [b]Thread[/b] is connected, base [b]Threads[/b] are severed.
[*]After: When the [b]Threads[/b] connected to a target are severed, [b]each severed Thread[/b] inflicts [b]700%[/b] of [b]Needle[/b] damage. When [b]Threads[/b] reach Max Stack and a new [b]Thread[/b] is connected, base [b]Threads[/b] are severed.
[/list]
[h3][b]Relic Adjustments[/b][/h3]

[b]Jewel Scarab[/b]

Previously, this relic had an overly punishing debuff compared to other relics. Now, it has been slightly buffed.
[list]
[*]Before: Inflicted with the [b]Curse of the Jewel Scarab[/b], decreasing all damage dealt by [b]30%[/b] for the next 3 battles. When [b]Curse of the Jewel Scarab[/b] is removed, all damage is increased by 20%.
[*]After: Inflicted with the [b]Curse of the Jewel Scarab[/b], decreasing all damage dealt by [b]20%[/b] for the next 3 battles. When [b]Curse of the Jewel Scarab[/b] is removed, all damage is increased by 20%.
[/list]
[b]Dream Catcher[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: Increases all damage by [b]0.3%[/b] for each [b]1 Dice[/b] used.
[*]After: Increases all damage by [b]0.5%[/b] for each [b]1 Dice[/b] used.
[/list]
[b]Smiling Ouija Board[/b]
[list]
[*]Before: All damage is increased by [b]4%[/b] per [b]tag[/b] removed.
[*]After: All damage is increased by [b]5%[/b] per [b]tag[/b] removed.
[/list]
[b]Cracked Swan Doll[/b]

Due to its high power as a Tier 2 Relic, we reduced the number of relics you could gain.
[list]
[*]Before: You may choose to forfeit the next stage’s [b]Relic[/b] and select this stage’s [b]Relic[/b] [b]3 times[/b].
[*]After: You may choose to forfeit the next stage’s [b]Relic[/b] and select this stage’s [b]Relic[/b] [b]2 times[/b].
[/list]
[b]Glass Butterfly[/b]

Buffed to provide better return relative to its risk.
[list]
[*]Before: All damage dealt is increased by [b]15%[/b]. However, all damage received is increased by [b]50%[/b].
[*]After: All damage dealt is increased by [b]25%[/b]. However, all damage received is increased by [b]30%[/b].
[/list]
[b]Red Shoes[/b]

Buffered to improve risk-reward value.
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Cooldown[/b] of all cooldown skills is decreased by [b]12%[/b]. However, [b]Max HP[/b] is decreased by [b]30%[/b].
[*]After: [b]Cooldown[/b] of all cooldown skills is decreased by [b]20%[/b]. However, [b]Max HP[/b] is decreased by [b]25%[/b].
[/list]
[b]Tripod Scissors[/b]

This relic was powerful, but its damage penalty was too harsh in some builds.
[list]
[*]Before: In exchange for decreasing the number of attacks [b]required for Scissors to critical hit[/b] by [b]1[/b], all damage is decreased by [b]20%[/b].
[*]After: In exchange for decreasing the number of attacks [b]required for Scissors to critical hit[/b] by [b]1[/b], all damage is decreased by [b]10%[/b].
[/list]
[b]Beast Gloves[/b]

Reworked to be a core relic for close-range sustained damage builds.
[list]
[*]Before: [b]Sharpness Max Count[/b] increases by [b]100%[/b]. When dealing damage with Scissors, increase [b]Sharpness[/b] by [b]50%[/b]. 
[*]After: [b]Critical Hit DMG[/b] of Scissors is increased by [b]50%[/b].
[/list]
[h1][b]Closing Notes[/b][/h1]
For this beta test, we’ve added a new [url=https://discord.gg/2Cv7zrayFR][b]Beta Test[/b][/url] channel to our official Garden of Witches Discord server. We will review your feedback on the beta version of our game in this channel, and we will do our best to implement your feedback in the official update wherever possible.

Please feel free to share your thoughts on Discord. Your active participation is what helps us continue to evolve our game.

Thank you for your continued support and interest, and we look forward to seeing how Garden of Witches continues to improve and grow with our community.

notes.notes:
This is an announcement to guide you on how to participate in our beta tests. We conduct beta tests to gather feedback and performance issues prior to the official update. If you participate, you can give feedback through the [url=https://discord.gg/2Cv7zrayFR][b]beta test channel[/b][/url] on our official [b]Discord[/b] server. We will take all of your feedback into consideration. 

[h1][b]Back Up Your Save Data[/b][/h1]
The beta version and the standard version of Garden of Witches share the same save files, so after playing the beta, your save file may not load properly in the standard version. We highly recommend you to back up your save file before playing the beta.

How to back up your save data:
[olist]
[*]Press the shortcut keys [b][WIN + R][/b] or right-click the [b]Windows Start button[/b] and select [b]Run[/b].
[*]Enter: [b]%AppData%\\..\\LocalLow\\Team Tapas\\Garden of Witches\\Steam\\[/b]
[*]Click [b]OK[/b].
[*]Open the folder named with your [b]Steam account ID[/b].
[*]Copy the save data file to a separate location for backup.

notes.title: Early Access Launch Feedback and Upcoming Updates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/4355b75260eab1794dbbd4234c591736ff4156a9.png[/img]

Greetings from Team Tapas!

First of all, we’d like to thank you for supporting and playing Garden of Witches’ Early Access release. Your many comments, reviews, and words of encouragement have been a tremendous source of strength for us.

Since the Early Access launch last week, we have been fixing critical bugs based on your feedback while also carefully reviewing every piece of feedback you have given us. There’s a lot to take in, but we’ve had extensive discussions about how to improve the game and the direction of our future updates. 

Today, we’d like to share a brief summary of all the patches we’ve done during the past week as well as some of the feedback and issues we have collected. Then, we’ll talk about the upcoming updates we have planned.

[h1][b]Patch Notes 0.5.0_b102[/b][/h1]
As a rule, we usually share patch notes via announcements whenever there is an update to our game. However, due to the urgency of some bugs, we rolled out a few updates in advance. We apologize for the delay in sharing the patch notes, but in the future, we will make sure to announce patch notes in a timely manner.

Here are fixes included in this update:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where sound effects would not play after the ending of the final chapter.
[*]Fixed an issue where players could acquire more than four scissor attributes under certain conditions.
[*]Fixed an issue where after obtaining the [i]Cracked Swan Doll[/i] relic, tags removed by choosing the [i]Crying Ouija Board[/i] could still appear as selectable attributes with the [i]Sewing Kit[/i] relic.
[*]Fixed an issue with the endgame content score tracker where the most recent score was displayed instead of the highest score.
[*]Fixed an issue in Chapter 1 where rewatching the ending scene would result in only being able to fast-forward the cutscene instead of allowing the player to skip it.
[*]Fixed an issue where if the player moved to another chapter before clearing Chapter 5 and then cleared that other chapter, then they would not be able to return to the chapter they were originally on.
[/list]
[h1][b]Known Issues[/b][/h1]
The following issues have been confirmed and reproduced by the dev team, but they require additional time to resolve. We are doing our best to identify the causes and to fix them as quickly as possible. We appreciate your patience in the meantime.

[list]
[*]Some relics do not function according to the values in their descriptions.
[*]The mouse cursor does not disappear during gameplay under certain conditions.
[*]There are long loading times when entering a combat zone for the first time after launching the game.
[*]FPS drops during some boss fights, especially with Nahatra (including the second phase).
[list]
[*]We have identified some optimization-related issues and are currently working on them.
[*]We plan on releasing a public beta build to test these fixes, so we would greatly appreciate your participation!
[/list][*]Players occasionally get stuck in walls when using the [i]Ambush[/i] skill.
[*]Enemies sometimes get stuck on objects and are unable to move.
[*]Abnormal angles appearing in the grid pattern of one of Nahatra’s attacks.
[*]Various graphical, animation, and visual effect issues.
[*]Various translation errors.
[/list]
[h1][b]Issues We're Looking Into[/b][/h1]
The following issues are issues the dev team has not been able to reproduce yet. If you could share more detailed information via Discord, we will do our best to resolve them as quickly as possible.

[list]
[*]Dash does not activate when attempting to dash while pressing the up and left buttons.
[*]Nintendo Switch Pro Controller is not recognized properly.
[*]Buttons on the Nintendo Switch Pro Controller are assigned incorrectly.
[*]The skip button does not work during the credits scene after the ending.
[*]In rare cases, save data becomes corrupted and prevents gameplay.
[*]Blood Clot amount does not increase even after acquiring a Blood Clot.
[/list]
[h1][b]Confirmed User Feedback[/b][/h1]
Based on the feedback we’ve received so far, although there are several areas that need improvement, we believe the game has generally received positive responses. 

Many of the features we tested internally and deliberated upon are functioning as intended. However, we acknowledge that there are shortcomings with content volume, difficulty balance, visual clarity, and UX, which we may have overlooked or underdeveloped.

Below are the issues we’ve identified based on user feedback.

[h2]Chapter 1[/h2]
Although Chapter 1 may feel somewhat easy, we believe it plays an important role in allowing players to quickly immerse themselves in the game and story while enjoying the basic progression system. However, many users pointed out that Sil’s initial movement and attack speeds felt too slow during their first playthrough.

We intentionally set the stats lower to create a clear sense of improvement when players experience their first death and upgrade their stats in Sil’s house. That said, this design choice might give the impression that the tempo of the game’s combat is slow, which we think is problematic.

[h2]Chapter 2[/h2]
This chapter introduces the [i]Synergy System[/i], a core element of the game, and it has generally received positive feedback. However, there is a noticeable lack of explanation regarding map rewards and the effects of various attributes.

[h2]Chapter 3[/h2]
In Chapter 3, enemy HP is significantly higher than in Chapter 2. This results in longer progression times, which may cause the pacing to feel slow or tedious depending on the player’s build and playstyle. We think this is a problem.

Furthermore, from Chapter 3 onwards, the performance gap between strong and weak builds becomes much more pronounced. During development, we balanced enemy HP based on high-performing builds, which seems to have caused the overall difficulty to skew too high for those using weaker builds.

However, the core issue we are looking at is how to help players understand which builds are possible and how each system works. Players often lack a clear understanding of how to optimize their build, leading to trial-and-error without a clear goal. We’d like to provide a better learning process to make the trial-and-error process less frustrating and more clear.

Relics also offer relatively limited variations to builds.

[h2]Chapter 4[/h2]
Compared to Chapter 3, the increase in difficulty appears to be reasonably tuned in terms of raw stats. However, some boss patterns were set to be too aggressive, and we’ve received feedback that certain boss patterns or mechanics felt overly difficult to learn or react to.

In particular, the second phase of the final boss relies heavily on pattern memorization rather than reflexive reaction, making it more difficult to master. While we believe a certain level of challenge is appropriate for the final boss, the current learning curve seems to be unnecessarily high.

[h2]Boss Pattern Difficulty[/h2]
We’ve received frequent feedback stating that Sil’s movement speed is too slow, that the dash cooldowns are too long, and that melee builds feel underwhelming. We believe these issues largely stem from boss patterns being too difficult to learn and being unfavorable for close-range combat.

Our dev team aimed to maintain a balanced ratio between patterns that players could react to in real time and patterns that required repeated attempts to learn. However, we recognize that this balance may need to be re-evaluated more carefully.

[h2]UI[/h2]
We designed the current version of the UI with a temporary layout that was easy to modify and expand. Throughout the Early Access period, we plan to fix various UI-related issues, refine the system, and gradually improve the interface.

By the time the full release comes around, we intend to enhance the visual design and add more detailed effects to polish the UI.

[h2]Other Feedback[/h2]
The following issues are issues we are aware of and issues that we are planning to address gradually throughout Early Access. We will continue to make improvements based on your feedback.

[list]
[*]Balance between spells, relics, scissor types, and dual synergies.
[*]The impactful feel of hitting enemies and getting hit
[*]Visibility issues with area-based attacks
[*]Repetitiveness in maps and regular monster encounters
[*]Limited overall content volume
[*]Lack of story content or side content
[*]Lack of build diversity
[*]Need for controller vibration and key remapping options
[*]Lack of a post-game summary screen or access to past play records
[*]Need for a true “skip” function instead of just fast-forwarding through story scenes
[/list]
[h1][b]Summer Update[/b][/h1]
Among the issues we shared above, we consider the lack of content volume to be our highest priority to address.

Below is a brief sketch of how we plan to expand the game’s content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/a41d6cbd59b5a4f02759907c21fecabac284c121.png[/img]

We are currently aiming for a summer update that coincides with the Steam Summer Sale starting [strike]June 23[/strike] June 26 (edited). Since there isn’t much time left, we’re not sure how much we can get done, but we’ll do our best to deliver a solid update.

If we are short on time, we may release only a part of the update or push the schedule back slightly. We will share the development progress with you along the way to gather your ideas and to better identify what needs improvement.

[list]
[*]Epilogue Chapter 1
[list]
[*]A new story featuring a different witch set far in the future from Chapter 5
[*]A new gameplay style with its own rules
[*]A simple progression system that only affects this chapter
[/list][*]New Skills and More Scissors
[list]
[*]Through the epilogue, a new ability will be unlocked that uses a new button (Keyboard: shift / Gamepad: RB)
[*]We plan on adding 3 new skills that players will be able to choose from, similar to how skills and attributes are currently selected.
[*]New scissors tied to these skills will also be added.
[/list][*]Side Missions
[list]
[*]We plan on adding about 10 side missions that can be attempted at any time while progressing through the main story.
[*]These missions will be simple challenges that require understanding the game’s core mechanics and will have accompanying rewards for clearing them.
[*]For example:
[list]
[*]Chapter 2: Missions to practice the Counterattack skill or to learn certain mechanics like thread + charge, HP management, and Butterfly Step.
[*]Chapter 3: Missions that hint at powerful builds
[*]Chapter 4: Missions that make use of different scissors.
[/list][*]Note: These will not be simple tutorials but engaging challenges with meaningful goals and rewards.
[/list][*]Balance Updates (for boss patterns and overall difficulty)
[/list]
[h1][b]Upcoming Plans[/b][/h1]
[h2]Full Release[/h2]
The full release will take place after a sufficient amount of content has been added. We are tentatively aiming for the Winter Sale at the end of this year at the earliest, but given the small size of our team (of about 6-7 people), there’s a high chance we may not meet that target.

That said, our top priority is to deliver a satisfying amount of content and quality rather than rushing to meet a deadline. Steam-related features such as Achievements and Trading Cards will also be added at the time of the full release.

[h2]Additional Epilogue Chapters[/h2]
In addition to the epilogue chapter planned for the Summer Update, we also plan to add another chapter around autumn. By the time of the full release, we aim to have at least three epilogue chapters, each with a unique gameplay system.

However, we currently lack strong ideas for entirely new gameplay mechanics. If you have fun or interesting ideas for epilogue chapters, please feel free to share them through our Discord community or other channels!

[h2]New Scissors, Skills, and More[/h2]
We will introduce new scissors and skills among other things through the new epilogue chapters.

Currently, some new scissors are being tested. As for new spells, it’s been a challenge to design entirely new mechanics that are distinct from our existing spell lineup, especially considering the need to align them with existing synergies and attributes. Because of this, it may be difficult to add new spells.

Instead, we aim to provide a more engaging gameplay experience by introducing a new skill button in the upcoming Summer Update.

[h2]Outfit Customization System[/h2]
We are planning to add a system where players can unlock various outfits and dress Sil with their preferred outfit of choice. You’ll be able to unlock outfits through various gameplay features like Challenge Mode and Side Missions.

[h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]
A full-featured Challenge Mode is scheduled to be added at the time of the official release. We aim to design enjoyable challenges that utilize the playstyles from both the main chapters and epilogue chapters.

※ Note: 
The Challenge Mode currently in the Early Access version was added as a temporary feature for some of our short-term goals such as testing various difficulties.

It will be removed later. So records from the Early Access will not apply to Steam Achievements or platform milestones in the future. However, for those who have already achieved high scores, we may create a legacy records scoreboard for viewing.

[h2]Additional Platforms[/h2]
We plan to release the mobile version (Android, iOS) of Garden of Witches after its full release on Steam. It will be a paid app with no ads or in-app purchases. The price is yet to be determined but will be decided based on the pricing models of similar games.

We’re also preparing for console releases (Nintendo Switch, PlayStation) shortly after the full Steam release.

Support for Linux and macOS is also under consideration. However, since we have no prior experience with porting to consoles or other OS platforms, we cannot yet be certain how smoothly this will go. We will share more details once we’ve conducted further research.

[h2]Discount Policy[/h2]
We plan to participate in all major Steam sale events. Until the full release, discounts will be capped at 20% unless Steam offers a special promotion. The OST bundle pack will likely continue to be available at a 10% discount as well assuming no issues arise.

[h2]Voiceovers & Dubbing[/h2]
We are currently prioritizing Korean and Japanese voiceovers and considering English dubbing. We are especially interested in English voiceovers, as it seems well-suited to the game’s atmosphere.

However, due to cost concerns and the fact that this is our first attempt at implementing voiceovers, we anticipate some trial and error. So we cannot commit to it yet. If things work out, we may consider running a crowdfunding campaign alongside selling physical merchandise (goods) to help fund adding this feature to our game.

[h1][b]Closing Remarks[/b][/h1]
There are still many things we couldn’t cover in this announcement, but please know that we are carefully reading through all of your feedback. We would like to sincerely thank all of you who have sent us your many thoughts and suggestions.

As this is our very first attempt at developing a PC game, we are putting in our utmost effort to create something truly enjoyable, and we hope to continue receiving your valuable feedback.

Thank you again, and see you again in our next announcement!

※ Edited on 25.06.02
Originally, we said the Steam Summer Sale started on June 23, but the actual date is June 26.

notes.title: May 23 Early Access Launch Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings from Team Tapas!

How’s everyone feeling now that spring is in full bloom?
We’ve been hard at work putting the finishing touches on the Early Access version of Garden of Witches, and after a long wait, we’re thrilled to finally share some exciting news:
Garden of Witches is launching on Steam Early Access on [b]May 23, 2025 at 5 AM EDT / 9 AM UTC! [/b]🎉

To thank you for your patience and support during the long wait, we’re excited to give you a sneak peek at what’s coming in Early Access—and how it will differ from the full version.

[h1]📖Main Story – Chapters 1 to 5[/h1]
In Early Access, you will be able to enjoy the main story of Garden of Witches up to Chapter 5.
The story you experienced in the demo will finally continue, and the backstories of various locations and characters will be revealed one by one.

Join our quirky coven of witches as they embark on a journey to bring the garden back to life.


[h1]⚙️System Expansions – Key elements added to each chapter[/h1]
The real fun of Garden of Witches is just getting started.
In the Early Access build, new systems will be unlocked gradually as you progress through the chapters, adding depth to your play and making your strategic choices increasingly important.

[h2]🧬Chapter 2 – Synergy System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/f8dafb7ec9717c1d304612667dbcab11bb8e3b2a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/361dce83475226e9e81812228942274761449caa.png[/img]
(This is a development-in-progress image; its content is subject to change.)

Synergies are powerful additional effects that are activated when you collect 2, 4, or 6 Attributes of the same “tag."
Effects are especially powerful upon collecting 6 of the same tag, and you can also combine multiple tags in groups of two or four to target multiple effects simultaneously.

It's up to you whether you wish to focus on a single tag for maximum effect or mix and match tags to create a more flexible build.
This system will allow for a wider range of strategies, making it easier to adapt to challenges of various kinds.


[h2]🔮Chapter 3 – Relic System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/5ded6f4b48985712f200b80d45455f3bf219bcb6.png[/img]
(This is a development-in-progress image; its content is subject to change.)

Starting from Chapter 3, a new Relic system will allow you to add more depth to your battles.
Each Relic provides a unique and powerful effect, and players can use them to immediately fill in gaps in their ability or strategize to maximize their power later in the game.

The key to using these Relics effectively is to understand your current playstyle, and then carefully select the Relics that best complement it.
A split-second choice can turn the tide of battle and determine the direction of your entire build.


[h2]✂️Chapter 4 – Weapon Select System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/c836ec93dcb97bc37ea9ee7a063888cc04ef68aa.png[/img]
(This is a development-in-progress image; its content is subject to change.)

In Chapter 4, you will be able to choose between different weapons.
Each weapon has its own unique battle style and method of attacking, adding to the fun of crafting the optimal build combination of Spells, Attributes, Synergies, and Relics.

For example, the “Broken Scissors” allows you to attack in rapid succession by holding two separate halves of the scissors in each hand, like a pair of twin swords.

Enemies will become increasingly powerful as you progress to the endgame, but if you can make the right choices by considering all the factors that affect battles, you will be more than capable of overcoming any challenge.


[h1]🎯Difficulty Adjustments and Skill Balancing[/h1]
A number of adjustments have been made to the overall difficulty and balance of the game based on player feedback.
[list]
[*]The names of the difficulties selected at the start of the game have been changed:
[list]
[*]Old: Story / Casual / Normal
[*]New: Story / Normal / Hard
[/list][*]Stage compositions have been reworked, and the overall difficulty has been adjusted
[/list]Overall adjustments have also been made to skill balance.
In particular, after our initial rework of the “Counter” skill, we received many comments that it was still too powerful.
Following this latest adjustment, the Counter skill —previously powerful even without any buildup—will gain a new niche as a high-risk, high-reward skill that rewards players with a good combination of control and strategy.


[h1]🔓After Story – Endgame Content and Challenge Mode[/h1]
After clearing Chapter 5, you will unlock temporary Endgame Content that will allow you to tackle greater difficulties of gameplay while you wait for the next update.

This content will provide the opportunity to experiment with new combinations, builds, and strategies, giving you plenty to do even after clearing the story chapters.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/db7d566d4248e54d2d80327287c9ef22523cdcef.png[/img]

Greetings from Team Tapas!

It’s hard to believe December is almost upon us. We’ve been so immersed in development that we didn’t notice how Christmas carols have already crept into the streets. We know you’ve been eagerly waiting for us to give further updates, so before the year ends, we wanted to share our current plans with you. 

[h1]Early Access[/h1]
We have been carefully reviewing all the feedback you have given us from the demo, and we are currently developing the Early Access version. Our target release date for the Steam Early Access is May 2025.

The demo version of the game you played only had two bosses and was only a part of Chapter 1. The Steam Early Access version will expand the game with three more bosses and complete the game’s story with four additional chapters (total of five story chapters).

In each chapter, you will face the same bosses, but their attack patterns will change and the overall difficulty of each stage will increase. On top of that, each chapter will introduce new systems for you to strengthen Sil, so we hope you will enjoy experimenting with different builds and find strategies to defeat the increasingly challenging bosses.

Below is a detailed outline of our roadmap leading up to our Steam Early Access in May.

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
[h2]Taipei Game Show Participation (January 2025)[/h2]
For the Taipei Game Show, we will have an updated demo that includes all of Chapter 1. Players will be able to fight against five bosses and see how the story progresses. This will be a valuable opportunity to receive direct feedback from users in person.

To prepare for this event, our entire development team has been fully committed to perfecting this demo version of the game using all of the feedback that you have given us. Further details about the game show will be shared later.

[h2]Stove Early Access Release (March 2025) [/h2]
[b]※ The schedule has changed from February to March.[/b]

Initially, we planned to release the Stove Early Access simultaneously with the Steam Early Access. However, as this is our first PC platform release and because we are a small indie development team, we thought that we would face a lot of challenges in terms of staffing, localization, and other issues. So we are planning to first release a partial version of Garden of Witches (up to Chapters 2-3) in Korean on the Stove store.

Our focus for this release will be on testing and gathering feedback from Korean users, so that we can refine the game for the Steam Early Access. Since the Stove Early Access release will be a partial version of the game, we will offer the game at a slightly discounted Early Bird price.

※Please note that even if you do not live in Korea or do not speak Korean, you can still purchase the Stove version from the Stove store, but only the Korean version of the game will be available until the Steam Early Access launch. Once the Steam Early Access is released, the same content and multilingual support will be updated on the Stove store.

[h2]Steam Early Access Release (May 2025)[/h2]
For this version of the game, we aim to release the game with all five story chapters and proper localization for multiple languages. This version will allow players to experience most of the game’s content. During this time, we will gather player feedback and address bugs and other issues so that we can further polish the game.

[h2]Official 1.0 Release (TBD)[/h2]
After leaving Early Access, we will address remaining issues (if any) and work towards including additional endgame content that will follow the conclusion of the story.

[h2]Closing Remarks[/h2]
We’d like to end our post by sending our sincere thanks and gratitude to you and everyone who has been involved in our community. Thank you for being patient with us and showing so much interest in our game. We will do our best to match the amount of patience you’ve had with us, so that we can deliver a polished and enjoyable experience based on your feedback.

We will organize and share additional updates as soon as possible.

Thank you!

notes.title: User Feedback and Future Updates for Garden of Witches
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149819/4b8a4417a301c62ccb50c0a87a5febe4acc1fa7f.png[/img]

Greetings! We are Team Tapas.

We would like to send our sincere gratitude to everyone who played the demo version (v0.3.8) of Garden of Witches.

We are currently receiving a lot of feedback and are carefully reading through all of it. While some changes can be implemented quickly, and others may take longer, we aim to update the aspects that can be addressed first before Steam's Next Fest begins.

[b]#Improvements to Early Stages of Gameplay[/b]
It seems that more attempts than expected are required to defeat the first boss. Even after understanding the boss's patterns, the high cost of upgrading movement speed and scissors attack speed seems to demand excessive retries. Additionally, the first area has more general combat sections compared to the second area, which may cause the players to feel tedious. As a result, we plan to implement the following changes:

- Reduce the cost and number of stages for upgrading movement speed, scissors attack speed, and dash recharge count
- Shorten the general combat section leading to the first boss by one stage.

[b]#Skill Balance[/b]
Internally, we believe the overall skill balance is fairly good. However, since not all systems are revealed in the demo version, it might appear somewhat unbalanced. Particularly, magic skills with utility effects still deal similar damage when compared to pure offensive spells. However, we anticipate this will change with the systems introduced after the full release, potentially reversing the performance and providing new experiences as mechanics evolve.

For now, we will focus on improving the usability and tooltips of the skills in the demo version, and we welcome further feedback.

[b]#Boss Battle Difficulty[/b]
The boss battle difficulty in the demo was set at a maximum level, which is barely clearable by experienced players without upgrades. As a result, those who are new to this game genre or boss pattern mechanics may find it somewhat difficult. However, most players seem to clear the boss without major issues after becoming familiar with the patterns and upgrading a few key abilities.

Therefore, we plan to maintain the current difficulty for boss battles in this demo. In the full release, there may be options such as adding difficulty settings or adjusting phases depending on the overall length of combat.

[b]#UI, UX[/b]
For players new to the game, we will work on reducing the amount of excessive information or addressing areas where information is lacking. Additionally, we aim to make any difficult-to-understand explanations more intuitive. While there will always be room for improvement, we will continue to refine the game's usability as much as possible.

[b]#Bug Fixes[/b]
We are working to resolve identified issues, such as the problem where using an ambush attack on enemies in the corner causes players to move outside the map and the issue where the exploding butterfly doesn't disappear when transitioning to phase 2 of the first boss fight.


Any additional issues will be included and addressed in the next update, so we appreciate your continuous feedback.

We will continue incorporating your valuable feedback to create a more refined game.

Thank you!

notes.notes:
Greetings! We are the indie game development team, Team Tapas.
We are excited to announce that the Steam page for Garden of Witches has now been released! 👏

Garden of Witches is our first game to be released on the PC platform. While it has been quite many things to adjust compared to the mobile platform we have worked on before, our entire team is having a blast creating it, and we can’t wait to share the finished game with you as soon as possible.

We are all working hard to make this a fun game, so please look forward to it!

[b]About [Garden of Witches][/b]

Garden of Witches is a roguelike game where you can enjoy fast-paced action with new skills and builds.
Take on the role of the protagonist "Sil" and explore the unique gardens of different witches as you try to prevent disaster. Convince the other witches to join you at the tea party!

[b]About Steam Next Fest[/b]

Garden of Witches will participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, which will begin on October 14th. During the event, a demo version featuring the early part of the game will be released, so we hope you’ll check it out and actively participate in the event!

[b]Upcoming Plan[/b]

Garden of Witch is currently scheduled for release in early 2025.
We are working hard on development, and future updates will be posted on the Steam community page. 
If you’re interested in our game, be sure to add Garden of Witches to your Wishlist to receive the latest news and show your support!

Additionally, we have opened an official Discord channel, where users can post their feedback and discuss the game. 
Feel free to join the channel and share your thoughts on Garden of Witches. 

[b]Other FAQs[/b]
Q: What languages can I play the game in?
A: Garden of Witches supports a total of 9 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, Italian, Spanish, and French.

Q: Will the game support controllers?
A: Yes, we plan to support most game controllers, including Xbox Controller and DualShock.

Q: What are the system requirements for the game? 
A: As the game is still in development, we can’t specify exact system requirements just yet. However, we are putting a lot of effort into optimization to ensure that the game can run smoothly even on mobile. The game features mainly 2D resources with light 3D elements, so high specs won’t be necessary.

We’ll be back with more news soon!
Thank you!
